title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch with causal winding and setting, stored reserve, event-resolved Swiss lever geometry, and a reserve-coupled balance whose amplitude can decay into a low-energy stall.

facts.Current pass: M5c damping + discrete impulse packets + low-amplitude unlock failure / restart
